description: Multi-Book Risk Surface by Office Solution The Multi-Book Risk Surface is an enterprise-grade visual engineered for Market Risk Managers, Trading Desk Heads, and Risk Officers in Power BI. It consolidates multi-dimensional risk exposure across trading desks, risk factors, and tenor buckets into a unified interactive risk surface. Users can analyze Value-at-Risk (VaR), Expected Shortfall (ES), and key Greek sensitivities (Delta, Gamma, Vega, Theta, DV01) side-by-side without toggling disjointed tables and standalone reports. Key Concepts: Multi-Dimensional Heatmap Surface: Matrix layout showing trading books across underliers or maturity tenors with dynamic risk-density color scales. Linked Greek Polar Radar: Integrated polar radar chart displaying the multi-axis Greek profile (Delta, Gamma, Vega, Theta, DV01) for selected desks. Scenario Delta Analysis: Compare baseline risk against stress scenarios (+100bp Rates Shock, Equity Crash, Covid 2020) to isolate capital impact. Risk Contour Isoline Overlays: Curved isolines connecting risk concentration regions to immediately pinpoint portfolio vulnerabilities. Contextual Position Drill Drawer: Slide-out drawer revealing underlying trading positions, ticket IDs, and scenario sensitivity ladders. Key Features: Executive Risk KPI Ribbon: Real-time tiles showing Firm VaR (99%), Expected Shortfall, Top Risk Desk, Worst Stress Delta, and…
